Image 1 is the approved selected-theme visual baseline, STRICT style reference. Image 2 is actual bloom-animation 5x5 sprite atlas, artwork reference ONLY. Use one appropriate frame in a bloom-capable Pulsar screen; never show sprite grid. Near-black FLAT interface, white sans typography, lilac accents, OPEN left aligned reading order, no cards, no decorative graphics/device frames/gradients. Large left elapsed clock, small useful dose and recipe total water above, established animation to clock's right only when applicable. Main current physical task, limited source-useful copy, full-width grounded primary footer above distinct separated two-line background session row when a background is specified. No background row when none; no empty placeholders. Every screen stable/footer readable, scroll content if necessary rather than overlapping/footer clipping. Label each state ID and short name OUTSIDE phone screenshot on surrounding neutral board margin. Within app no design commentary. Use exact supplied text naturally spaced, break long lines. This is a static design proposal, no new sensors/measured masses/automatic actuals. Timer elapsed is known; task completion requires source-specific explicit report in guidance. Primary footer is not forced report in basic mode. Large screen-side margins, simple Android icons only. Render supplied content carefully.
Board: Cold serving and cleanup
SCREEN 1 [C09 Dilute serving]: Coldguide,no bloom, no runningclock. 'Make a 200 g serving'. '100 g concentrate + 100 g cold water'. 'Serving water, separate from the 400 g brew water'. 'Before ice or milk'. Visible 'Keep unused concentrate covered at 4 °C or colder'. Primary 'Serving ready'. No coffeestrength/caffeineclaim.
SCREEN 2 [C10 Clean up]: Coldguide,no bloom,no runningclock. 'Wash and dry equipment'. 'Discard grounds and filter'. 'Keep unused concentrate covered at 4 °C or colder'. Primary 'Finish brew'. Small50gcoffee/400gextractionwater as recipecontext, notyield.
SCREEN 3 [C11 Cold completed]: Cold,no bloom. 'Brew complete'. '50 g coffee · 400 g extraction water'. '14 h 08 m reported steep time'. 'Keep unused concentrate covered at 4 °C or colder'. Primary 'Done'. No storagelifeguarantee, no measuredyield.
